name: Iceland — Golden Circle, South Coast & Snæfellsnes

stops.name: Keflavík Airport
stops.notes: Landed 6:05 AM after the overnight flight from Boston; picked up the rental car.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Walked downtown: Rainbow Street to Laugavegur, then the old harbor and the Sun Voyager.

extras.name: Sun Voyager (Sólfar)
extras.photo: 1990 zum 200-jährigen Jubiläum von Reykjavik wurde die Skulptur Solfar (Sonnenfahrt) enthüllt. 01.jpg

stops.name: Þingvellir
stops.notes: Rift valley, tectonic plates.

stops.name: Geysir
stops.notes: Geothermal area; watched Strokkur erupt.

stops.name: Kerið
stops.notes: Crater lake.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Clockwise loop. Watched for the aurora until ~2 AM.

stops.name: Eldhraun lava field
stops.notes: Left Reykjavik at 10:00 AM. Moss-covered lava field.

stops.name: Fjaðrárgljúfur
stops.notes: Canyon.

stops.name: Kirkjugólf
stops.notes: Basalt 'church floor' at Kirkjubæjarklaustur.

stops.name: Foss á Síðu
stops.notes: Waterfall off the cliff edge, right by the road.

stops.name: Dverghamrar
stops.notes: Basalt columns.

stops.name: Jökulsárlón
stops.notes: Short evening visit, after several unplanned roadside glacier viewpoints.

stops.name: Skyrhúsið Guesthouse, Hali
stops.notes: Night 1 away from Reykjavik.

stops.name: Jökulsárlón
stops.notes: Ice cave tour (moved from the 9:45 to the 10:15 departure), then the lagoon in daylight until ~2:15 PM, with lunch there.

stops.name: Diamond Beach
stops.notes: Ice chunks on black sand, across the road from the lagoon.

stops.name: Fjallsárlón
stops.notes: Quieter glacier lagoon.

stops.name: Svínafellsjökull
stops.notes: Glacier viewpoint, added on the day.

stops.name: Skaftafell
stops.notes: Full hike up to Svartifoss; back at the car by 6:45 PM.

stops.name: Fox Hostel, Hrífunes
stops.notes: Night 2 away. The last stretch past the bridge is rough. Clear sky, no aurora.

stops.name: Skógar Museum (Skógasafn)
stops.notes: Rain and 10–15 m/s wind, milder than the forecast storm. Turf houses and folk history; parking included with the ticket.

stops.name: Katla Visitor Centre & Shipwreck Museum
stops.notes: Geopark exhibition and shipwreck museum.

stops.name: Víkurkirkja
stops.notes: Walked up in the evening.

stops.name: Vík Hostel
stops.notes: Night 3 away.

stops.name: Yoda Cave (Gígjagjá)
stops.notes: A short hop east of Vík first thing.

stops.name: Reynisfjara
stops.notes: Black sand beach, basalt columns.

stops.name: Dyrhólaey
stops.notes: Coastal promontory, arch rock.

stops.name: Sólheimajökull
stops.notes: Glacier viewpoint.

stops.name: Skógafoss
stops.notes: Plus the upper trail to just past Steinbogafoss.

stops.name: Kvernufoss
stops.notes: Waterfall a short walk in from Skógar.

stops.name: Rútshellir
stops.notes: Man-made cave dwellings by the road.

stops.name: Seljavallalaug
stops.notes: Old geothermal pool in a valley, ~20 min walk in.

stops.name: Seljalandsfoss
stops.notes: Walked behind it, plus Gljúfrabúi. Flat tire here: the rear right tire dropped to 0.8 bar with no spare, so roadside assistance repaired it. Skipped Urriðafoss because of it.

stops.name: Laugardalslaug
stops.notes: Evening soak back in Reykjavik.

stops.name: Borgarnes
stops.notes: Left Reykjavik at 7:30 AM; filled up on gas here.

stops.name: Ytri Tunga
stops.notes: Seal beach, but no seals that day.

stops.name: Búðakirkja
stops.notes: The black church.

stops.name: Rauðfeldsgjá
stops.notes: Gorge in the mountainside.

stops.name: Arnarstapi
stops.notes: Cliffs and the Gatklettur arch (the short walk).

stops.name: Lóndrangar
stops.notes: Basalt sea stacks.

stops.name: Djúpalónssandur
stops.notes: Black pebble beach, shipwreck remains.

stops.name: Saxhóll
stops.notes: Crater with a stairway to the rim.

stops.name: Kirkjufell
stops.notes: Under low cloud with poor visibility; Kirkjufellsfoss alongside.

stops.name: Reykjavik
stops.notes: Skipped Skarðsvík and drove straight back over Route 56. Dinner at Grazie.

stops.name: Keflavík Airport
stops.notes: Returned the car at 1:57 PM. Flew FI631 at 5:10 PM, arriving in Boston at 6:50 PM.

extras.name: Múlagljúfur
extras.notes: For a future visit: Canyon near Kvísker; skipped on Day 4 to make up time.

extras.name: Urriðafoss
extras.notes: For a future visit: Waterfall off Route 1 near Selfoss; skipped on Day 6 because of the flat tire.

extras.name: Reykjadalur hot river
extras.notes: For a future visit: Hot river hike near Hveragerði; the weather ruled it out.

extras.name: Viðey Island
extras.notes: For a future visit: By ferry from the old harbor.

extras.name: Perlan Museum & Öskjuhlíð forest
extras.notes: For a future visit: Museum and forest walk.

extras.name: Esja
extras.notes: For a future visit: Half-day hike north of the city.
